name: supermemory
description: Memory and context engine + app that is extremely fast, scalable, and can be run fully locally. The Memory API for the AI era.
one_liner: A plug-in memory system that lets any AI app remember things about a user across conversations, instead of forgetting everything the moment the chat window closes.
buyer: A founder building an AI chatbot product (customer support, personal assistant, coaching app) who doesn't want to build memory infrastructure from scratch.
business_use_cases: A customer-support SaaS adds persistent memory to its AI chatbot so it remembers a returning customer's past issues, reducing repeat-explanation friction.
An AI coaching or journaling app uses it to give the assistant continuity across sessions, a key feature customers pay for.
A dev agency offers 'add memory to your AI product' as a scoped integration project for startups whose chatbots currently reset every session.

money_ideas.idea: Offer integration consulting to add persistent memory to an existing AI product
Run a hosted, managed version for teams that don't want to self-host, billed by usage

steal_this: This weekend, build a small demo showing a popular open-source chatbot gaining persistent memory with it, then pitch the integration as a paid gig to indie chatbot builders.
